description: This file defines interfaces related to stream namespace predicates used for filtering implicit subscriptions in Orleans. It includes the IChannelNamespacePredicate interface for checking if a namespace matches certain criteria and the IChannelNamespacePredicateProvider interface for creating predicate instances from pattern strings.

classes.name: IChannelNamespacePredicate
classes.description: Interface for predicates that determine if a given stream namespace should be subscribed to.

classes.name: IChannelNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Interface for providers that create IChannelNamespacePredicate instances from pattern strings.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Determines if the specified stream namespace matches the predicate criteria.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Property that provides a pattern string describing the predicate.

methods.name: TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to create a predicate from a pattern string; returns false if unable.
